digest.component_or_area: Jira reconciler: rich-text codec and sync
propositions: Markdown headings, lists, code, and emphasis currently render as literal source text in Jira Cloud (ADF) and Data Center (wiki), breaking content fidelity on cloud-to-Jira sync.
Jira-authored rich constructs (panels, mentions, dates) are lost or corrupted on inbound rebar reconciliation due to lack of origin-gating and echo-safety baseline tracking.
Bidirectional markdown↔ADF round-trip (Cloud) and markdown→wiki rendering (DC) must achieve idempotent fixed points without content erosion or echo loops across repeated reconciliation passes.

Comment sync must use append-only semantics with persistent local-to-Jira comment-ID maps and the same rich-text codec as descriptions, routing through codec-aware create/update paths for both targets.
DC pandoc subprocess invocations must be bounded per field, killed on timeout, and safely fall back to identity rendering without data loss; GPL/SBOM obligations for bundled binary must be recorded.

Concurrent local and remote rich-text edits must emit conflict flags instead of silent overwrites; unchanged second passes must not create redundant state entries; Jira-native constructs must survive rebar-originated reconciliation through origin-gated outbound normalization.
